name: account_activity
description: Log in, open the account activity page for account {{account_id}}, and read the transaction table into an output named transactions

approved_plan.goal: Log in, open the account activity page for account {{account_id}}, and read the transaction table into an output named transactions

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied credentials and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay fragment parabank_login@1.0.0 using username and password parameters

steps.intent: Navigate to the account activity page for the specified account
steps.action: Click on or navigate to the account link matching account_id (13344) to open its activity/transaction page

steps.intent: Read the transaction table from the account activity page into the transactions output
steps.action: Extract all rows and columns from the transaction table displayed on the account activity page and capture them as the transactions output

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The account ID whose activity/transaction page should be opened

approved_plan.success_signal: The Account Activity page is displayed, showing a transaction table with column headers (e.g. Date, Description, Debit, Credit) for the specified account

review_notes: s03_extract: only one locator candidate (css) — no fallback if it stops matching

inputs.name: username
inputs.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

inputs.name: account_id
inputs.description: The account ID whose activity/transaction page should be opened

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

outputs.name: transactions
outputs.description: Read from the page during discovery; returned as text

business_outcomes.description: The requested account_id does not exist or is not accessible to the authenticated user; the application returns an error rather than an activity page.
The username/password combination was rejected during login; the user cannot proceed to any account page.
The account exists and the activity page loaded successfully, but the transaction table is empty — there are no transactions to return.

when.value: The username and password could not be verified.

then.message: Login failed: the supplied username or password was not accepted by ParaBank.
An unexpected error banner appeared during the login subflow. Inspect the page for details.

steps.description: Navigate directly to the account activity page for account {{account_id}}

when.value: Could not find account with id:

then.message: The account_id '{{account_id}}' was not found in ParaBank. Verify the account exists and belongs to the authenticated user.
ParaBank returned an internal error when loading the account activity page. The application may be unavailable or misconfigured.

steps.description: Transaction table from the account activity page

then.message: The account activity page loaded but contains no transactions. An empty result has been returned.

on_exhausted.message: The transaction table was not present on the account activity page, indicating the account has no recorded transactions.

target.description: Transaction table from the account activity page

success.description: Text the discovery model proved success with
